decisive_spans.text: The biopsy results showed spongiosis and erosions in the epidermis and a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis with a peripheral mantle zone surrounding a central germinal center with cells that were CD20 positive and BCL-2 negative

response.rationale: The biopsy results directly support Cutaneous Pseudolymphoma and contradict Lichen Planus and Pityriasis lichenoides chronica. The additional finding of erythema after UV-A irradiation further supports Cutaneous Pseudolymphoma.
